exposure: route of apical pelvic organ prolapse (POP) surgery (abdominal, robotic, vaginal)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 610 women who underwent apical pelvic organ prolapse (POP) surgery via abdominal, robotic, or vaginal routes between May 2005 and May 2016.
finding: Perioperative blood transfusion was significantly more common in abdominal apical pelvic organ prolapse surgeries (11.1%) compared with robotic (0.5%) and vaginal (0.5%) approaches.
